usage: bike-replay [-h] [--episode EPISODE] [--viewer]
                   [--time-scale {1,2,4,8}] [--view] [--speed SPEED] [--loop]
                   [--fps FPS] [--dry-run]
                   recording

Verify a saved research episode by physically replaying every recorded input.
With ``--view`` the recording is instead played back visually in the MuJoCo
viewer (see ``bike_sim.sim.ride.playback_viewer``); ``--view --dry-run``
sweeps the trajectory headlessly without opening a window.

positional arguments:
  recording

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --episode EPISODE     research episode ID; required for multi-episode
                        containers
  --viewer              show the same checked replay in a viewer
  --time-scale {1,2,4,8}
                        viewer playback speed; does not change recorded
                        physics
  --view                play the recording in the MuJoCo viewer instead of re-
                        verifying it
  --speed SPEED         initial playback speed multiplier (with --view)
  --loop                wrap at the end instead of holding the last frame
                        (with --view)
  --fps FPS             viewer frame rate / dry-run frame granularity (with
                        --view)
  --dry-run             with --view: sweep the trajectory headlessly; no
                        window opens
